test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

"Buy pure and natural honey of company Z" - an advertisement.

**Assumptions:**

I. Artificial honey can be prepared.

II. People do not mind for paying more prices for pure and natural honey.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
Both assumption I and II are implicit.

solution:
The statement gives an advertisement promoting pure and natural honey of company Z.

 
• Since it is promoting pure honey, it implies that artificial honey can be prepared. So, assumption I is implicit.
 
• Nothing about the pricing of pure or artificial honey has been stated, so assumption II is not implicit.

Hence the correct answer is **option 2**.
